Definition: from a compound of G5056 and G5342; to be a bearer to completion (maturity), i.e. to ripen fruit (figuratively):--bring fruit to perfection.
BiblicalUsage: The word is to bring to completion, to bear fruit to maturity. The seed among the thorns is choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bringeth no fruit to perfection.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that thorns do not kill the seed at once; they choke it slowly, and the fruit never ripens.
